what: What winning requires, computed against the whole field for the first time
ranking_rule: FAQ: sum your ranking in each metric, lowest sum wins. Twelve boards.
rule_sensitivity: under absence = tied last we are still 7th and Izus still leads; only a rule ignoring unentered boards changes it, and that rule would rank a one-entry team 2nd, so it is not the rule

why_first_is_out_of_reach.to_reach_rank_1: every clip at 0.9567, our single best in 30
why_first_is_out_of_reach.conclusion: the leaders typical clip beats our second best: recipe and training scale, not selection or cleanup

what_is_purchasable.method: donor transfer, measured 3 of 9 at $0.37/clip with one donor each; best-of-N per clip is legal on Tier 1 because its permitted input IS the scoring reference

the_decisive_unknown.question: is the 1-in-3 rate per attempt or per clip
the_decisive_unknown.per_attempt: any clip is rescuable with tries; 6 attempts gives 91 percent per clip and $41 buys ~10 clips
the_decisive_unknown.per_clip: three of the nine were rescuable and six never will be; extra attempts buy nothing
the_decisive_unknown.the_test: 3 clips x 4 donors = 12 cells = $7. If a clip that failed its first donor succeeds on a later one, the world is per-attempt. Buy this before anything else.

best_ratio_on_the_board: tier3-mp-sr: +3 clips is 7th to 1st, six rank points, because only 11 teams entered and the leaders pass 3 of 30. Also the least likely: we pass 1 and our Tier 3 position error averages 47.77 cm against a 3 cm gate.
recombination: closed properly: multi-start hill climbing over the whole 30-clip entry (4^30, 40 restarts, plateau term) against the rank sum finds 44 as a hard floor; best is 12.01783 cm, 0.0208 short of one point

the_answer.first: no -- a better tracker, not a purchase
the_answer.3rd: about $150-300 and nearly everything landing; one chance in four or five
the_answer.6th: about $40-60 if the Tier 1 rescue works at the measured rate; the realistic aim
the_answer.standing_still: wte09fl cost us two rank points this afternoon by uploading while we were idle
